beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus picked seventy of his followers and sent them out two by two, ahead of him, into every town he was about to visit.

timing.text: Jesus picked seventy of his followers and sent them out two by two, ahead of him, into every town he was about to visit.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He didn't send them with much — no extra bag, no spare sandals, no backup plan. Just each other, and a message.

timing.text: He didn't send them with much — no extra bag, no spare sandals, no backup plan.
Just each other, and a message.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

timing.text: The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There is so much to bring in, he told them, and hardly anyone to do it — so ask the owner of the harvest to send out more workers. Notice what he did not say. He did not say the fields were empty. He said the fields were full, and the crew was short.

timing.text: There is so much to bring in, he told them, and hardly anyone to do it — so ask the owner of the harvest to send out more workers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Wherever they were welcomed, they were to heal the sick and say the same simple thing.

timing.text: Wherever they were welcomed, they were to heal the sick and say the same simple thing.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

timing.text: The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That was the whole message. Not a warning, not a threat — an announcement that the thing everyone had been waiting for had just walked into their town.

timing.text: That was the whole message.
Not a warning, not a threat — an announcement that the thing everyone had been waiting for had just walked into their town.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And they came back with joy, amazed at what had happened when they used his name:

timing.text: And they came back with joy, amazed at what had happened when they used his name:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

timing.text: Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Lord, even the evil spirits obey us when we use your name. They were thrilled, and they had every right to be. And then Jesus told them what to actually celebrate.

timing.text: Lord, even the evil spirits obey us when we use your name.
They were thrilled, and they had every right to be.
And then Jesus told them what to actually celebrate.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

timing.text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Don't be glad about that, he said. Don't let the power be the thing that thrills you. Be glad about this instead: The power was temporary and it was never really theirs. The name in the book was permanent, and it was theirs before they ever left on the trip.

card.text: Your name, written in heaven — that's the joy he wanted them to keep. It's meant for you as well.
